layouts.name: Penbay International Circuit
layouts.description: Draft route hypothesis: the source cycle is the unique closest nominal-distance match within conservative timing and distance checks. Approximate OSM trace length 3520.1 m. Difference from the supplied layout distance 6.9 m. Course configuration still requires visual review.

layouts.name: Penbay National
layouts.description: The National course retains the full northern outer loop, western main straight and middle eastern hairpin, closing through the short western U-return. The public all-roads snapshot supplies every course section except the short junction from way 645849365 index 55 to way 645849366 index 4. That junction is independently digitized from continuous pavement in the pinned June 18, 2026 image. The southern outer loop, southern oval, northern shortcut and separate eastern karting circuit are excluded. Junction precision is limited to native 10 m imagery; operating direction and final corner placement require review. Native satellite ground resolution is 10 m. Nearest-neighbor rendering does not add resolution. Fine corner alignment and historical direction remain draft; no vertices are fitted to private diagrams, timing positions or nominal distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 1964.5 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.title: Aggregate layout identification
sources.evidenceNote: Configuration set contains the identified International course, northern oval and southern oval. The supplied aggregate identity includes the northern closing shortcut, full middle hairpin, southern oval and southern crossing branch. These three independently mapped component routes reproduce those branches from exact public course nodes. The western National U-return is a separate configuration and is excluded. The tourism authority identifies the venue as a motor-racing circuit; licensed June 2026 public imagery independently confirms the separate karting site and paddock are excluded. Aggregate branch length 3,864.0 m is not a single-lap distance. Identification only; no image coordinates copied.
